content.thinking: No void invoices exist despite status V being documented, and 'NULL' shows up as a string value that needs verification. Next I'll check the GL entries, reversals, and period linkage.

input.sql: SELECT h.*, (SELECT string_agg(l."LN_SEQ"||':'||l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||':'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO" LIMIT 30

SELECT 'unbalanced' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_no_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_no_hdr', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line_bad_acct', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE l."ACCT_CD"=c."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'both_dr_cr', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_line', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_vend', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_bad_jrnl', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_bad_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_without_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ne_inv_amt', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'post_dt_outside_period', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" OR h."POST_DT">p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'post_after_close', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'closeDT_is_null', count(*) FROM "GLPERD" WHERE "CLOSE_DT" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'refjrnl_is_null', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "REF_JRNL_NO" IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv', count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_not_AP', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."SRC_CD"<>'AP'
